title: Αναθεώρηση προγράμματος πληρωμάτων ασθενοφόρων ΕΚΑΒ

unsupported.quote: Μετά από νυχτερινή βάρδια να ακολουθούν δύο ημέρες ελεύθερες.
unsupported.reason: A sequence pattern that depends on the type of the previous shift: min_rest applies one minimum gap after every shift, and no template forbids work on the days that follow a night shift only.

notes: Each crew is a driver and a rescuer, so every shift has one row per position with its head count (2 ambulances in the morning, 1 in the afternoon, 1 at night); the driver row needs 'οδηγός' in the person's Θέσεις list and the rows of one shift overlap, so 'one position at a time' binds. proschedio.csv is the draft already circulated: it is not bound by the truth (no declared dialect: UTF-8, ','), and the stability baseline is its 56 pairs written inline. The draft was produced by the same reference search under every mandatory rule of section 4, but without the two new absences and the shared-car request; it puts Karampetsos on two afternoon positions during his sick leave and Mouratidou on the Monday afternoon that overlaps her seminar. The night-off request (5δ, no shift starting on the two dates after a night) is a wish: the draft honours it fully (enforced by a scratch check). After the two absences it cannot be fully honoured: the reviewer's exact search proved that no plan keeps it together with the hard rules, because from Wednesday each day needs all 12 staff (6 day positions, 2 night positions and 4 people resting after the two previous nights). The reference solution breaks it twice. With the 11-hour rest at most one shift starts per date and with at most five days in a row at most six dates are worked, so the 48-hour cap can never bind; it is kept as a faithful encoding of 4δ. The two absences are stated separately, so they are two unavailable rules (ADR-0007 section 4). Reference score 42, best found: 3 changes are forced by the absences and every search needed 4 (20); Roussou's zero nights force a night spread of 2 (4); the shared-car pair is apart on 9 positions (18), because pairing them costs more draft changes than it saves. Disruption: Orestis Chatzis is ill on Saturday 14/11 (he works the Saturday night); a feasible re-plan exists (hard 0). Sources (facts only, changed where useful): Ministry of Health answer (April 2026) giving EKAB sector strength per shift as morning/afternoon/night, e.g. 2/2/1 ambulances; the PDF has no readable text layer for our tools, so the figures come from the search index - https://www.hellenicparliament.gr/UserFiles/67715b2c-ec81-4f0c-ad6a-476a34d732bd/13262397.pdf ; ambulance crews are rescuers, the driver included (specialty 'Διασώστης - Πλήρωμα Ασθενοφόρου') - https://minedu.gov.gr/publications/docs2024/epag_ekpaideusi/ΔΙΑΣΩΣΤΗΣ_-_ΠΛΗΡΩΜΑ_ΑΣΘΕΝΟΦΟΡΟΥ.pdf ; 48-hour average week including overtime and 11 hours of daily rest - https://employment-social-affairs.ec.europa.eu/policies-and-activities/rights-work/labour-law/working-conditions/working-time-directive_en
